sn45.149:2.1: (The fully-recited suttas belonging to the peyyālā beyond the Ganges should be told in full.)
sn45.149:3.1: Mendicants, all the hard work that gets done depends on the earth and is grounded on the earth.
sn45.149:3.2: In the same way, a mendicant develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path depending on and grounded on ethics.
sn45.149:3.3: And how does a mendicant grounded on ethics develop and cultivate the noble eightfold path?
sn45.149:3.5: That’s how a mendicant grounded on ethics develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path.
